title: Bill Payment Calendar — Overview and definition
body: Signature edition. Original Signature methods and framings developed for the JAH system, labeled Signature throughout. Tracks due dates for bills and recurring expenses with reminders. The Bill Payment Calendar tracks due dates for bills and recurring expenses. Rent, utilities, phone, subscriptions — each gets a due date, amount, and autopay status, with reminders a few days before. Paid bills are checked off, and the upcoming-month view shows the total cash needed before it is due.
capabilities: Track every bill's due date and amount
Remind days before each due date
Mark autopay vs manual bills
Check off paid bills
Show next month's total cash needed
